text.dbReadme:
SQLite through `node:sqlite`, built into Node.js: nothing to install and no Docker. The
database is the file in `SQLITE_PATH` (default `./database.sqlite`, git-ignored), and each
repository creates its table when missing.

```bash
npm run db:seed        # sample data
```

Node.js still marks `node:sqlite` as experimental and prints a warning when it loads.
